# Source attribution

NCI Thesaurus (NCIt), National Cancer Institute, release 26.08e.

Pinned release: https://evs.nci.nih.gov/ftp1/NCI_Thesaurus/Thesaurus_26.08e.FLAT.zip
Format and release notes: https://evs.nci.nih.gov/ftp1/NCI_Thesaurus/ReadMe.txt
Terms: https://evs.nci.nih.gov/ftp1/NCI_Thesaurus/ThesaurusTermsofUse.pdf

Downloaded 2026-09-25. The catalog records the archive SHA-256; `source_concepts.json` retains the exact source synonym/parent/category fields used by the mappings. Source definitions are not imported into chatbot answers. The hierarchy is the stated source hierarchy, not inferred KG relationships.

KG name fields and abbreviations are taken from the frozen node records identified by `coverage.json`. They are explicitly confirmation-only and are not asserted as externally certified equivalences. All original node, edge and publication identities remain unchanged.
